messages:
Marie (AE): Customer asks for an HSM attestation they can attach to audit. They want HSM model/firmware, cert chain, and a nonce-based cryptographic proof that key ops happened in the HSM. Also need cost for one-off attestation + quarterly subscription.

Sanjay (SalesEng): We can do nonce challenge-response: customer provides nonce, we sign it with their KEK in HSM, return signature + cert chain + redacted audit ref. No raw keys or firmware images. Need FIPS level.

Marie (AE): They require FIPS 140-2 Level 3 and import path details for CMK.

Olivia (Security): I'll draft attestation text: include HSM make/firmware, signed nonce, cert thumbprints, and import path summary (KMIP/PKCS#11 steps). State we never export key material.

Ben (SalesOps): Pricing ballpark: one-off $10k-$16k (NRE + compliance); quarterly $2.5k/quarter. On-site inspection extra. I'll add SOW lines.

Sanjay (SalesEng): PoC runbook stub: customer posts base64 nonce -> Redwood runs internal hsm.sign(key_id, nonce) -> return {signature_b64, cert_chain_pem, audit_id}. Customer verifies signature.

Olivia (Security): Also attach supported APIs and cert chain examples in the attestation packet.

Marie (AE): Action items: Olivia draft attestation by EOD tomorrow; Ben add pricing to SOW; Sanjay prepare 2-hr PoC runbook. I'll set call with customer.
